Room.title: Room
Room.description: A shared bamboo calendar date-polling room created by a user.

title.description: Display title of the gathering or event.

startDate.description: Start date of the polling range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

endDate.description: End date of the polling range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

creatorId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the room creator.

creatorName.description: Display nickname of the room creator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the room was created.

Vote.title: Vote
Vote.description: A single user's watering vote on a specific date inside a room.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the participant who watered.

nickname.description: Participant nickname displayed on the calendar tile and top-7 view.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the water vote was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the water vote nickname was last updated.

/rooms/{roomId}.description: Shared calendar rooms indexed by short unguessable room IDs.

/rooms/{roomId}/votes/{voteId}.description: Water votes for dates within a room, keyed deterministically as {dateStr}__{userId}.
